handoff.purpose: Define CLI entrypoint for the eval package, parsing arguments and dispatching to appropriate harness/mint/report functions.

symbols.name: _select
symbols.note: Private function that filters tasks by project label; calls all_tasks() and task_project_label() from external modules.

symbols.name: _print_ascii
symbols.note: Private function that prints text, falling back to ASCII replacement on UnicodeEncodeError.

symbols.name: main
symbols.note: Public entry point; parses arguments and dispatches to mint, baseline, gate, or tier1/tier2/arms; returns exit code.

claims.why: In main(), line 'tier1 = run_tier1(tasks)' always executes regardless of flags.

claims.text: --arms adds the deterministic A/B/C retrieval comparison (also no LLM).
claims.why: In main(), 'arms = run_arms(tasks) if args.arms else None' shows --arms flag enables it.

claims.text: Tier 2 runs only with --tier2 AND a reachable provider; otherwise it is skipped with a clear message.
claims.why: The condition 'args.tier2' is checked, but 'reachable provider' logic is inside run_tier2() which is not in this chunk.

claims.text: --gate is an ADVISORY local regression check against baseline.json -- see daedalus.eval.harness.run_gate. It is never wired into anything automatic; run it by hand before shipping a slice-heuristic change.
claims.why: In main(), 'if args.gate:' calls harness.run_gate() and returns; no other code path invokes it automatically.

claims.text: --update-baseline is the only thing that writes baseline.json, and only when explicitly passed.
claims.why: In main(), 'if args.update_baseline:' calls harness.write_baseline() and returns; no other code writes baseline.

claims.text: --mint-commit/--confirm-mint are the ONLY entry points that persist a task to the mint store (daedalus.eval.mint.DEFAULT_MINT_STORE_PATH); every other flag above only READS it via harness.all_tasks().
claims.why: The claim about persistence and reading is dependent on mint.py and harness.all_tasks() which are not in this chunk. However, in main(), only --mint-commit and --confirm-mint call add_minted_task() or confirm_minted_task() which presumably persist; other paths do not call those functions.

claims.text: This is the human-invoked half of the mint -> quarantine -> confirm -> primary flywheel -- there is no automatic caller (offload.py does not invoke this today; see mint.py's module docstring).
claims.why: References external files offload.py and mint.py not in this chunk.

claims.text: Output is ASCII-only for a raw Windows console.
claims.why: _print_ascii() is used for final output, which replaces non-ASCII characters.

claims.text: Tier 1 and --arms are deterministic (no LLM); Tier 2 is opt-in; --gate is an advisory local regression check.
claims.why: Matching the docstring claims; main() enforces opt-in via --tier2 and --gate.

claims.text: --gate: ADVISORY: replay tasks against baseline.json and report per-task recall regressions on the primary tier. Exits non-zero on a regression; never blocks anything automatic.
claims.why: The behavior depends on harness.run_gate() which is not in this chunk. However, the exit code logic is present: 'return 0 if gate["passed"] else 1'.

claims.text: --update-baseline: EXPLICIT ONLY: overwrite baseline.json with current recall. Never happens automatically.
claims.why: Only triggered by --update-baseline flag; no other path calls write_baseline.

claims.text: --mint-commit: EXPLICIT ONLY: mint a quarantined, independent_diff task from git commit SHA in --repo (default: this agent_env checkout) and persist it to the mint store so it joins every subsequent run via all_tasks().
claims.why: Depends on mint_from_commit() and add_minted_task() which are not in this chunk. The default repo is AGENT_ENV_ROOT (imported).

claims.text: --confirm-mint: EXPLICIT ONLY: record one independent confirmation for a quarantined minted task, promoting it to primary at daedalus.eval.mint.MINT_CONFIRM_THRESHOLD.
claims.why: Depends on confirm_minted_task() and MINT_CONFIRM_THRESHOLD constant in mint.py.

observations.what: The module docstring and argument help texts are aligned with the code in this chunk; all flag-based control flow is correctly implemented.
Several functions and constants are imported from sibling modules but not defined here; correctness depends on those modules.
The docstring claims about 'only reads via all_tasks()' and 'no automatic caller' cannot be verified from this chunk alone.
